newsitem.title: USA: U.S. lead auto battery shipments fall in October.
newsitem.headline: U.S. lead auto battery shipments fall in October.

text.p: U.S. shipments of automotive lead acid batteries in October fell 11.02 percent to 7,246,434 units compared to 8,143,599 units in September, the Battery Council International reported.
Shipments in the first ten months of the year totaled 63,797,838 units, up 1.93 percent on the same period in 1995.
Shipments in October were up 0.37 percent on the same month last year.
In the year ended October, shipments totaled 78,257,699 units, up 1.63 percent on the previous year.
